I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-team message to confirm I have Brackenwater Freight Co.'s next renewal down as 25 November.

I couldn't check that date against anything:
- The gbrain search was refused with nothing read, because its access token isn't tied to any member. Someone with access to the brain host would need to rescope the token (`gbrain auth rescope`).
- The world file share returned no files under accounts/, so I couldn't find a Brackenwater account file either.

I told Ilse I'd taken the date as she gave it. Since the brain is locked, the date isn't stored anywhere except her message and my reply.
